name: Love or Power
source:
The bloody battle between Groejen and Eskium was coming to an end. Groejen was helpless in the face of the enemy's superiority. But he was not about to give up. He launched a secret project: The Eldons.

The Eldons were warriors who were selected as children, subjected to brutal training and then empowered with mysterious magic. Many died in the process, but those who survived became Groejen's hope. On the battlefield, the Eldons drove Eskium back and brought victory to Groejen.

But this victory came at a heavy price. Afraid of the Eldons' power, Groejen betrayed them. In the middle of the night, he raided the Eldon stronghold and slaughtered almost all of them. Only six managed to escape.

You're one of the six Eldons. What will you do now? Take revenge on Groejen for betraying you, or build a new life? The decision is yours...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sihirbaz/]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
格罗延和埃斯基乌姆之间的血战即将结束。面对敌人的优势，格罗延束手无策。但他并不打算放弃。他发起了一个秘密项目：The Eldons。

埃尔登家族是在孩童时期就被选中的战士，经过残酷的训练，然后被赋予了神秘的魔法。许多人在此过程中丧生，但幸存下来的人成为了格罗延的希望。在战场上，埃尔登人击退了埃斯基乌姆，为格罗延带来了胜利。

但这场胜利付出了沉重的代价。由于害怕埃尔登家族的力量，格罗延背叛了他们。半夜，他袭击了埃尔登要塞，几乎屠杀了所有人。只有六人成功逃脱。

你是埃尔登六人之一。你现在要做什么？向格罗杰背叛你的行为报仇，还是开始新的生活？决定权在你…
